source.author: verg
source.text: Atque illi medio in spatio chorus ecce suarum occurrit comitum: nymphae, quas alma Cybebe numen habere maris nymphasque e navibus esse iusserat, innabant pariter fluctusque secabant, quot prius aeratae steterant ad litora prorae.
source.text_original: Atque illi medio in spatio chorus ecce suarum / occurrit comitum: nymphae, quas alma Cybebe / numen habere maris nymphasque e navibus esse / iusserat, innabant pariter fluctusque secabant, / quot prius aeratae steterant ad litora prorae.
source.text_english: And behold, in the midst of the space there met them a company of their own attendants: the nymphs, whom kindly Cybebe had ordered to have the nature of the sea and to be nymphs from the ships, were swimming alongside and cleaving the waves, as many as the brazen prows had previously stood at the shore.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: o si mihi sanguis, quantus erat, cum signiferum cratera minantem non leviore Pholum manus haec compescuit auro, primus in aeratis posuissem puppibus arma concussoque ratem gauderem tollere remo.
reuse.text_original: 'o si mihi sanguis, / quantus erat, cum signiferum cratera minantem / non leviore Pholum manus haec compescuit auro, / primus in aeratis posuissem puppibus arma / concussoque ratem gauderem tollere remo.
reuse.text_english: O if only I had had blood, such as it was when this hand checked Pholus, banner-bearer and threatening with the goblet, not with less gold, I would have been the first to place arms on bronze-clad ships and would have rejoiced to lift the vessel with the shaken oar.
